shortDescription: Gym member check-in result view with multiple account states.
fullDescription: Home route for the member check-in result experience. It resolves the requested check-in state from route search params and renders the shared member result layout for success-active-member, payment-method-invalid-past-due, and membership-cancelled-access-denied scenarios.

shortDescription: Reusable member check-in result screen component.
fullDescription: Shared presentation component for the gym member check-in flow. It renders the connected header, member-number search bar, status hero, member details, amenities list, and bottom guidance banner, and supports success, payment warning, and cancelled-membership states through a state prop and shared member fixtures.
